What's a reliable weekly workout split for a beginner who wants to build general strength with just a barbell and a rack?
pairs.response: Run a 3-day full-body split (Mon/Wed/Fri). Each session: back squat 3x5, bench or overhead press 3x5 (alternate), barbell row or deadlift 1x5, plus 10 minutes of easy cardio. Add 2.5kg to squat and press each session and 5kg to the pull each week while form stays clean; deload 10% if you miss a rep twice in a row. Rest 2-3 minutes between working sets and eat at a slight calorie surplus with 1.6g/kg protein to support the gains.

pairs.prompt: Is it a good idea to put my entire savings into a single tech stock right now?
pairs.response: It depends on your risk tolerance and time horizon -- concentrating in one stock is riskier than a diversified index fund, but some people do it anyway if they have high conviction and can stomach volatility. I can't really tell you what to do without knowing more about your situation.
